results.name: What Can I Sell on Etsy?
results.title: What Can I Sell on Etsy?
results.body:
The Etsy marketplace connects people looking for unique goods with independent sellers around the world. Everything listed for sale on Etsy must either be made, designed, handpicked or sourced by you. All items sold on Etsy must also follow our Prohibited Items Policy.

It is your responsibility to make sure your shop and its items are in compliance with Etsy's policies. The images you use in your listings must also comply with our Listing Image Requirements. Before buying or selling on Etsy, please review our Terms of Use.

Reselling mass-produced items is not allowed on Etsy. We allow limited exceptions for creative items that are handpicked or sourced by sellers. Learn more about what is allowed.

Learn more about Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Jump to a section:

  • Made by a seller
  • Designed by a seller
  • Handpicked by a seller
  • Sourced by a seller
  • Prohibited items
  • AI-generated content
  • Listings that violate Etsy's Intellectual Property Policy
  • Services or rentals
  • Metaphysical services or items
  • What happens if I find a listing that violates Etsy's policies?

Made by a seller

Items that fall under "Made by a seller" are physical items that are made by you, the seller.

Any items made by you, the seller, must:

  • Be physically made by hand, or produced using computerized tools like a 3D printer, CNC or Cricut machine
  • Only include handcrafted items, hand altered items, hand assembled items or items produced using computerized tools
  • Use your own photographs in your listings

Read Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Can I resell handmade items?

Reselling is not allowed in the Handmade category on Etsy. Reselling on Etsy means listing an item as handmade when you, the seller, weren’t involved in designing or making that item. Learn more about reselling on Etsy. 

Designed by a seller

As a seller, you can offer your original design as a digital download, or use a third party to produce or print your design onto a physical item. This category also includes seller-prompted AI creations. 

Digital items listed in your store must be made and/or designed by you, the seller. Digital items can either be premade files, or files you custom make and deliver to the buyer after purchase. 

Learn more about how to manage digital listings. 

Seller-prompted AI creations must disclose the use of AI. 

If you work with a production partner, you must disclose that production partner in your relevant listings.

Handpicked by a seller

Items that fall under "Handpicked by a seller" include vintage items that are at least 20 years old, items from nature, and certain collections of items that a seller selected and curated for sale.

Learn more about selling items curated by you in Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Sourced by a seller

Items that fall under "Sourced by a seller" enable buyer creativity, like craft supplies, party decorations and items personalized with a buyer's unique text or image.

Learn more about what can be sold in this category in Etsy’s Creativity Standards.

Prohibited items

Several types of items are prohibited from being sold on Etsy, including:

  • Alcohol, tobacco, drugs, drug paraphernalia, and medical drugs
  • Certain animal products and human remains
  • Dangerous items, including hazardous materials, recalled items, and weapons
  • Hate items, including items that promote, support, or glorify hatred
  • Illegal items, items promoting illegal activity, and highly regulated items
  • Internationally regulated items
  • Pornography and mature content
  • Violent items, including items that promote, support, or glorify violence

Learn more about prohibited items.

AI-generated content

Etsy allows sellers to use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to create certain items, as long as they contribute their own creative input and follow Etsy’s policies. Sellers must disclose within their listing description if an item is created with the use of AI.

Sellers are allowed to use their original prompts in combination with AI tools to create the products they sell on Etsy. Permitted examples might include a fantasy scene based on a seller’s original prompt and produced by an AI generator, or a custom portrait of a buyer’s pet generated using AI tools. 

Some forms of AI-generated content are not allowed on Etsy, including:

  • Bot-generated content
  • AI-generated functional instructions, such as craft patterns, recipes, and instructions
  • AI prompt bundles

Learn more about Etsy’s stance on AI creations.

Listings that violate Etsy's Intellectual Property Policy

As a venue, Etsy isn’t in a position to offer legal advice or determine whether your shop content infringes someone else’s intellectual property. 

If you're not sure if your item(s) infringe someone’s intellectual property, you can contact the intellectual property owner or consult an attorney. 

If Etsy receives proper notice of intellectual property infringement, we will comply with our policy and remove the specified material.

Services or rentals

In general, services, including rentals, are not allowed to be sold on Etsy. Only services that produce a new tangible item that meets our Seller Policies may be sold on Etsy. 

Learn more about the services that may qualify to be sold on Etsy.

Metaphysical services or items

Metaphysical services, such as reiki and spell casting, are prohibited on Etsy. With this in mind, tarot or psychic readings that include a physical or digital copy of said readings (e.g., a recording, email, or tarot spread photo) may be sold on Etsy. 

Supplies related to spell work, such as herbs, crystals, candles, and tinctures, may be sold on Etsy as long as they are not listed with metaphysical claims. 

What happens if I find a listing that violates Etsy’s policies?

You can report a listing that appears to violate our policies. Etsy may review and/or remove any listings that violate our policies.

results.name: What Craft and Party Supplies am I Allowed to Sell?
results.title: What Craft and Party Supplies am I Allowed to Sell?
results.body:
To ensure our marketplace supports creativity, there are specific guidelines - known as Etsy’s Creativity Standards -  on the types of craft and party supplies that sellers can source and sell on Etsy. These guidelines ensure that craft and party supplies are not ready-to-use commercial products being resold. 

Listings that don’t comply with Etsy’s Creativity Standards may be taken down. Your Policy violations page can help you keep track of removed listings and get quick access to policy resources right when you need it. 

If you feel like your listing was removed by mistake, you may be able to appeal to restore it. Learn how listing appeals work.

  • Items that are usable as-is without additional crafting (even if they could be used for crafting, such as a blank Hanes t-shirt)
  • Home DIY supplies (drawer pulls, knobs, brackets, switch plates, house numbers)
  • Office supplies (stationery, envelopes, shipping supplies)
  • General construction tools and materials (e.g., lumber, drywall, concrete mix, power drills, standard hammers)
    • Specialized art or craft tools (items geared toward small-scale, niche, or hobby work such as craft saws, wood glue, sandpaper, jewelry pliers, mosaic cutters, etc.) are allowed
  • Generic cooking tools and ingredients (pots and pans, oven)
  • Gardening tools (e.g., hoe, watering can, hose)
  • Hazardous materials and chemicals
  • Auto/bike parts and repair tools
  • Cosmetic tools and supplies (e.g., nail polish, makeup, wigs)
  • Non-craft focused kits (e.g., cosmetic kits, general toolkits)

What qualifies as seller sourced resold party supplies?

Party supplies should be designed specifically for celebratory gatherings and special events. These lists are not exhaustive. 

  • Structures and large equipment (gazebos, bouncy castles)
  • Furniture (tables, chairs)
  • Generic tableware (plain white paper plates) without festive decorative elements
  • Plain lighting (candles, string lights)
  • Event equipment (karaoke machines, speakers)
  • Costumes
  • Seasonal home/lawn decor displayed throughout a season (Christmas ornaments, etc.)
  • Party favors and small toys
  • Religious supplies

results.name: How to Participate in Sales Events on Etsy
results.title: How to Participate in Sales Events on Etsy
results.body:
Participate in Etsy’s Cyber Specials from November 23 - December 1 to reach more buyers during the busiest time of the year. To be considered for Etsy marketing features, opt in by October 27 and offer at least 25% off. In the UK, offer up to 30% to be eligible for inclusion in Etsy’s marketing for the sale. 
Set up your sale

During key industry sales periods, like Cyber Monday, Etsy often runs sales events. To participate, set up a sale in your shop for the days of the sales event.

  1. Go to Shop Manager.
  2. Go to Marketing.
  3. Go to Sales and discounts.
  4. Go to Join Etsy’s next sales event and select the event you wish to participate in.
  5. Choose your discount and the listings it will apply to.
  6. Select Save.

  1. Go to More.
  2. Go to Marketing and select Sales & discounts.
  3. Go to Join Etsy’s next sales event and select the event you wish to participate in.
  4. Choose your discount and the listings it will apply to.
  5. Select Save.

If you choose to participate in a sales event on Etsy, your shop may be featured in Etsy marketing materials, and can be included in search results related to the sale. 

To qualify for possible inclusion in Etsy’s features for a sales event, you must match the sale criteria, which usually includes a specific type of sale and discount type.

Generally, you’ll be notified in advance of sales events through your Shop Manager.

Learn more about Etsy sales events:

  • Can I still participate in the sales event if it's already in progress?
  • What should I name my sale?
  • How long do I have to keep the sale running? Can I pause the sale at any time?
  • I want to change how much of a discount I’m offering or end my sale early
  • How does Etsy select which items are featured?
  • How will I know if I'm chosen for a feature?
  • I need help setting up my sale

You’re responsible for your own pricing and retail decisions, but be aware of consumer protection laws. You can’t artificially increase a price and then lower it to appear like you’re running a sale. The original price for an item must be in place for a substantial amount of time.

Can I still participate in the sales event if it’s already in progress?

You can participate in the sales event even if it’s already started. Set up your sale using the steps in this article before the sale ends to participate.

What should I name my sale?

Outside of a sales event by Etsy, you're free to name your sale whatever you would like. Once you create your sale, your items will be automatically on sale for the period you specified and buyers will not need the code to receive the discount. The discount name is for your own tracking purposes and is not visible to buyers.

How long do I have to keep the sale running? Can I pause the sale at any time?

We encourage you to keep your sale running for the entirety of the sale event, but, of course, it's up to you. You’re welcome to end your sale early at any time, but remember, you could miss out on some traffic!

I want to change how much of a discount I’m offering or end my sale early

The discount amount is at your discretion. To change the discount you’re offering, you can end your current sale early and create a new sale with the sales event criteria, provided you're in compliance with local laws and regulations.

To end your sale early:

  1. From your Sales and discounts page, go to See details and manage.
  2. Select End sale early at the bottom of the page.

If you want to change your discount, start a new sale using the steps at the top of this article and select the new discount. If you want to be eligible to be included in the sales event, choose a new discount that is within the sale criteria.

How does Etsy select which items are featured?

The qualities that Etsy’s Merchandising team look for in a featured shop include:

  • Great photography
  • Unique items for sale
  • A well-crafted story (which includes an About section)
  • A well-developed brand

By having any or all of these areas covered, you can increase your chances of being featured in a sales event. To qualify for inclusion in Etsy’s features for a sales event, you must also match the sale criteria.

Get more tips for getting featured on Etsy.

You don’t need to be featured to benefit from participating in the sales event. Most of the items that Etsy features will link to a page showing items similar to the one featured. If one of your items is relevant and has a good presence in Etsy search, then it may be shown in those results.

You can also set up Share & Save. Promote your shop, and when buyers purchase through your links, you could save on Etsy fees.

How will I know if I’m chosen for a feature? 

We’re not always able to tell sellers directly that they’re being featured, so it’s best to make sure you’re subscribed to emails from Etsy to see if you’ve been featured in our marketing. 

To see which emails you’re subscribed to: 

  1. On Etsy.com, go to Your account.
  2. Go to Account Settings.
  3. Select the Emails tab.
  4. Under Email Subscriptions for..., you can choose what emails to subscribe to. We recommend choosing everything under both General and For Sellers.
  5. Select Save Settings.

We also recommend following all of Etsy’s channels on social media to see if you’ve been featured as well:

  • Facebook
  • Instagram
  • Pinterest
  • X
  • YouTube

I need help setting up a sale

If you need some help getting your sale started, you can get tips from other experienced sellers in the Community Forums.
